purpose: Cover AC-15802-1 (rcf feedback preview on a shelf blueprint entry prints Stravica/rcf-lite as the destination and the CORE_REPO constant is pinned to packages/rcf-lite/package.json:bugs.url) and AC-15802-2 (a --kind core entry routes to Stravica/rcf-lite regardless of any library manifest content, including a library that names 'define validate' as a target).
title: Slice 3 (FBS-182): shelf blueprints and --kind core entries route to Stravica/rcf-lite via the package.json:bugs.url constant

testCases.description: Cover AC-15802-1 via the unit test: CORE_REPO equals parseBugsRepo(package.json), which today is Stravica/rcf-lite; the parser accepts the bare URL, the URL with the /issues suffix and the object form { bugs: { url } } so a rename ripples through the single package.json field.

Cover AC-15802-2 via the CLI test: a project with a registered library that declares a good issuesRepo, followed by a rcf feedback add --kind core --target 'define validate' entry; rcf feedback preview --json reports destination.repo Stravica/rcf-lite (kind: core, visibility: public) for that entry, ignoring the library declaration entirely.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-destinations.test.js::AC-15802-1: rcf feedback preview prints Stravica/rcf-lite (public) as the destination for a --kind core entry, and no library manifest content overrides it
